$comment: PR-27, PR-97. This project's own settings outside the repository, in the format of devos/setup.json; scripts/devos/setup-check.mjs reads them with DEV_OS's.

items.title: Supabase values the app reads (Vercel)
steps: Vercel → project → Settings → Environment Variables: the two NEXT_PUBLIC names for every environment; `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY` for **Production only**, marked Sensitive (service role; read only by server modules, guard:data rule 6).

items.title: The Tower's production URL (OIDC audience, host check)
steps: Vercel → Environment Variables → **Production**: `TOWER_URL` = `https://<the production hostname>` with no trailing slash. It is the OIDC audience every reporting project uses as `tower.url` (pilot ADR-005) and the host the machine routes accept (Tower ADR-004).
A custom domain later = a new audience: change it here and in every project's `tower.url` together.

items.title: GitHub App `devos-control-tower` webhook secret
steps: GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → GitHub Apps → New: name `devos-control-tower`; Webhook URL `<TOWER_URL>/api/github/webhook`; generate a secret; permissions READ: Actions, Checks, Commit statuses, Pull requests, Metadata; events: workflow_run, check_run, status, pull_request, installation, installation_repositories (Tower ADR-003). Install it on devos-pilot and devos-control-tower only.
Vercel → Environment Variables → **Production**: `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, Sensitive. Needed from T03.

items.title: The GitHub App exists and is installed
steps: Repository variable `DEVOS_GITHUB_APP` = `true` once the App is installed on the pilot and the Tower (T03 reads it as a precondition by name).
